exceptions.why: pnpm reads its hook file only under this exact name, and only as CommonJS, so it cannot be .ts
ESLint reads a TypeScript config only through `jiti`, which this repository does not install, so the flat config stays `.js` (#4274)

a PACKAGE FILE of an isolation fixture: `packages/guards/src/isolation-gate.ts` packs the fixture and installs the tarball into a throwaway consumer, so this file runs from that consumer's `node_modules/`. Node refuses it: `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING` ("Stripping types is currently unsupported for files under node_modules"), measured 2026-10-09 on Node 24.21.0 with a `.ts` package entry installed under a consumer's `node_modules/`; #4393
